slot_scores.name: demand_satisfaction_requirement
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Must all demand from July through December be fully satisfied (no backorders or unmet demand allowed), or can some demand be left unfulfilled?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether demand must be fully satisfied or whether unmet demand/backorders are allowed, directly covering the hidden slot.

slot_scores.name: initial_inventory_zero
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is there any initial inventory of either product at the start of July (i.e., inventory carried over from June), or does the schedule begin with zero stock?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about initial inventory at the start of July for either product, directly covering the hidden slot.

stopping_behavior.rationale: Both P0 and P1 hidden slots were resolved before the agent entered READY_TO_MODEL; remaining questions concerned P2 or boundary details.

summary: The agent systematically clarified key modeling assumptions, including demand satisfaction and initial inventory, before stopping. The interaction quality was strong with no unresolved P0/P1 slots.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
